title: Mlai mid scenario model not learning
topic: Mlai mid scenario model not learning
question: What would you check to debug why the model isn't learning?
idealAnswer:
Check the learning rate first, too high can cause instability or divergence, too low can look like the loss is barely moving because updates are tiny

Verify the loss function and labels are set up correctly, e.g. checking for a mismatch between logits and label encoding, or an incorrectly shaped output layer

Check that gradients are actually flowing, looking for vanishing or exploding gradients, especially in deeper networks without normalization or good initialization

Sanity-check on a tiny subset of data, even a handful of examples, to confirm the model can overfit it, if it can't even memorize a few examples, something is broken in the pipeline itself, not just tuning

Check data preprocessing, unnormalized inputs, shuffled label and feature mismatches, or a bug in the data loader are common, boring, and very common causes

Confirm the model architecture actually has enough capacity for the task, and that weights are initialized reasonably rather than all zeros or a bad scale
